Package com.hitorro.jsontypesystem

Class FieldDependencyGraph

java.lang.Object
com.hitorro.jsontypesystem.FieldDependencyGraph
public class FieldDependencyGraph extends Object
Extracts and analyzes the dependency graph between dynamic fields in a type definition. Dynamic fields declare their input dependencies via the "fields" array (e.g., [".text", ".lang"]).

Provides:

  • Direct dependency lookup
  • Topological sort (correct enrichment order)
  • Impact analysis (what downstream fields are affected by a change)
  • Cycle detection
  • Text and Mermaid visualization
